two_phase_commit.notes: Commit anchors only after atomic file move & manifest OK.

anchors_store.notes: HKAnchoredObjectQuery per type; emits deletions with {deleted:true}. ISSUE: Anchors in UserDefaults, should migrate to Keychain.

service_day_overlap_swift.notes: Deterministic max-overlap rule; ties → earlier day. 6 unit tests covering DST, ties, naps.

steps_deoverlap.notes: One aggregated record per service day; avoids double counting from watch+phone.

core_exporter.notes: Exports all 7 types; dual offsets; SHA-256 canonical hashing. Outputs .jsonl (not gzipped yet).

doselog_exporter.notes: night_key, doses, overrides, wakes → JSONL. Dual storage (iCloud + local).

encryption_settings_ui.notes: PBKDF2 (100k iterations), AES-256-GCM, strength meter, key rotation, keychain storage, RAM wipe.
